# data.fetch_data.load_timeseries_forecast { #spotforecast2_safe.data.fetch_data.load_timeseries_forecast }

```python
data.fetch_data.load_timeseries_forecast(data_home=None, on_missing='raise')
```

Load the day-ahead forecast time series from ``interim/energy_load.csv``.

Reads the ``Forecasted Load`` column and converts the index to a
UTC ``DatetimeIndex`` with hourly frequency.  Missing values are
**rejected** by default so callers cannot accidentally feed
imputed values into downstream safety-critical pipelines.  Pass
``on_missing='ffill_bfill'`` to opt into the legacy
forward/backward fill behavior that was the default before the
1.0 major release.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                          | Default   |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| data_home  | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[str](`str`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]\] | Root data directory.  If None, resolved via ``get_data_home()``.                                                                                     | `None`    |
| on_missing | [OnMissing](`spotforecast2_safe.data.fetch_data.OnMissing`)                                      | How to handle NaN rows in ``Forecasted Load``. ``'raise'`` (default) fails fast with the gap timestamps; ``'ffill_bfill'`` forward- then back-fills. | `'raise'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                                         |
|--------|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | pd.Series: Hourly forecasted-load series indexed by UTC timestamps. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                        |
|--------|------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [FileNotFoundError](`FileNotFoundError`) | If ``interim/energy_load.csv`` does not exist.     |
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`)                   | If ``Forecasted Load`` column is not present.      |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)               | If ``on_missing='raise'`` and the series has NaNs. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> import os, tempfile, shutil
>>> import pandas as pd
>>> from spotforecast2_safe.data.fetch_data import (
...     load_timeseries_forecast, get_package_data_home,
... )
>>> tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
>>> os.environ["SPOTFORECAST2_DATA"] = tmp
>>> interim = os.path.join(tmp, "interim")
>>> os.makedirs(interim, exist_ok=True)
>>> demo = get_package_data_home() / "demo01.csv"
>>> df = pd.read_csv(demo)
>>> df = df.rename(columns={
...     "Time": "Time (UTC)",
...     "Actual": "Actual Load",
...     "Forecast": "Forecasted Load",
... })
>>> df.to_csv(os.path.join(interim, "energy_load.csv"), index=False)
>>> y_f = load_timeseries_forecast()
>>> isinstance(y_f, pd.Series)
True
>>> shutil.rmtree(tmp)
>>> del os.environ["SPOTFORECAST2_DATA"]
```
